visualCharacteristics.layout: 2 columns: text on the left (about 50%), elevated calculator card on the right; the lattice canvas fills the band behind both

animation.dataAttributes: container: data-pattern="lattice" aria-hidden="true"; canvas: data-live="true" (CSS keeps the canvas at opacity 0 until data-live=true)
animation.depicts: Isometric lattice of light grey lines and nodes, densest at the right behind the calculator
animation.howItAnimates: Drawn and faded in on load (data-live). No change seen at rest or on pointer move: static after the intro. pointer-events:none
animation.dimensions: full band, 1280x631 CSS px at a 1280px viewport (position absolute, inset 0)
animation.migrationNote: The canvas is empty in cleaned.html. The block JS draws the lattice into a canvas (or inline SVG), with a static pattern for reduced motion

visualCharacteristics.interactive: Two-handle range slider over a histogram of package values (handles can pass; drag the band; arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End). It updates 'Estimated premium per package' live, and the CTA opens the quote drawer (QuoteDrawer-IDD6-v3F.js)

contentPattern.surroundingText: H1 'Shipping insurance for lost, damaged, or stolen shipments' (the last two lines are teal and underlined); paragraph 'InsureShield® Shipping Insurance helps businesses recover faster...'; button 'Talk to an expert'
contentPattern.calculatorText: H3 'What's your average package value?'; label 'Package value'; default range $100 to $1,000; 'Estimated premium per package' $0.80 to $10.50; CTA 'Estimate monthly premium'; disclaimer 'Estimate only. Actual pricing and availability depend on...'
rows: Text: H1 (emphasis in <em>), paragraph, CTA link
Calculator: H3 question, list of config (min $100, max $1,000, default range), result label, CTA link, disclaimer

usage: Top-of-page hero: headline, intro and CTA beside an interactive premium calculator, over a procedurally drawn isometric lattice background.
reuseGuidance: Use for a product hero that pairs marketing copy with an estimate tool. Calculator config is authored as "key: value" list items (Label, Min, Max, Stops, Low rate, High rate, Bars, Open ended). Without a second cell it renders a text-only hero over the lattice.
